_README: Reviewed factory defaults for dialects without a dedicated parser, read by app.facts.recognizers._absence.
Keys are the seed 'vendor' labels. Two kinds of entry, each with its source in the reason:
"predicate": "reason"  the dialect does NOT enforce the setting unless its configuration states it, so when
the dialect is understood and no line states it, it is decided NOT_SET (like an AAA server).
"predicate[:subject]": {"value": ..., "reason": "..."}  what the platform does when its configuration is
silent (assurance DEFAULT); applied only when no fact and no line so much as names the setting.
Only add an entry with its source; a guess here would turn a missing line into a false verdict.

Palo Alto PAN-OS.auth.password.min_length: PAN-OS ships with Minimum Password Complexity disabled, so no minimum length is enforced until 'set mgt-config password-complexity' enables it (PAN-OS Administrator's Guide, Device > Setup > Management)

mgmt.ssh.version.reason: "The Cisco NX-OS software supports only SSH version 2 (SSHv2)" (Cisco Nexus 9000 NX-OS Security Configuration Guide, Configuring SSH and Telnet)

mgmt.remote_access.protocol_enabled:teln.reason: "The Telnet server is disabled by default on the Cisco NX-OS device" until 'feature telnet' enables it (Cisco Nexus 9000 NX-OS Security Configuration Guide, Configuring SSH and Telnet)

mgmt.crypto.weak_allowed.reason: NX-OS offers only aes128-ctr, aes192-ctr and aes256-ctr until 'ssh cipher-mode weak' adds the CBC ciphers (Cisco TechNote 200663, Unable to SSH into Nexus 9K)

Check Point Gaia.auth.login.max_attempts: Gaia ships with 'set password-controls deny-on-fail enable off', so failed logins are not limited until it is turned on (Gaia Administration Guide R81.20, Configuring Password Policy in Gaia Clish)

mgmt.ssh.version.reason: "ExtremeXOS 16.2 supports SSH protocol version 2 from OpenSSH" (ExtremeXOS 16.2.5 release notes, Secure Shell (SSH) Server Upgrade)

boundary.source_routing.enabled.reason: 'accept-source-route' defaults to 'no' under /ip settings (RouterOS manual, IP Settings)

mgmt.remote_access.protocol_enabled:teln.reason: the ASA accepts Telnet only from the addresses a 'telnet <address> <mask> <interface>' line names, and never on the lowest-security interface outside a VPN (Cisco ASA General Operations Configuration Guide 9.1, Management Access)

mgmt.crypto.weak_allowed.reason: the default 'ssh cipher encryption medium' accepts 3des-cbc and the AES-CBC ciphers (Cisco TechNote 213283, Disable SSH Server CBC Mode Ciphers on ASA)

boundary.discovery_protocol.enabled:lldp.reason: LLDP runs only once 'set service lldp' enables the service (VyOS 1.3 documentation, Service > LLDP)

time.ntp.authenticated.reason: VyOS 1.3 offers no NTP authentication: a server takes only noselect, pool, preempt or prefer (VyOS 1.3 documentation, System > NTP)
